summary: Presents an object-oriented information model for representing Quality of Service (QoS) network management policies. It builds on the IETF Policy Core Information Model and covers QoS enforcement for differentiated and integrated services. As an information model, it is independent of any particular storage or protocol.

eli5.summary: Rules like which messages get to go first need to be written in a common way. This is a blueprint for describing such priority rules so different tools can understand them.
